info.name: FU News Management API
info.description:
Bo test API cho do an SBA301 - FU News Management System.

## Cach chay

1. Khoi dong backend truoc.
2. Kiem tra bien `baseUrl` cua collection, mac dinh `http://localhost:8080`.
   Neu backend chay cong khac thi sua lai cho dung.
3. Bam **Run collection** de chay tuan tu tu tren xuong duoi.

Cac request phu thuoc nhau theo thu tu: dang nhap truoc, tao danh muc, roi tao bai viet trong danh muc do, kiem tra validate, cuoi cung don dep.

## Khong can token

API dung phien dang nhap bang cookie `JSESSIONID`. Dang nhap mot lan o nhom 00, Postman tu giu cookie cho moi request sau do. Khong co buoc lay token nao.

## Tai khoan thu nghiem

`Admin` / `Admin` la Admin. `c@fu.edu.vn` / `123` la Staff.
